Pretty-print agent logs from .wombo-combo/logs/&lt;feature-id&gt;.log

Reads log files written by agents during headless runs and displays them with colorized output. Supports tailing and following.

Aliases: `lo`

```sh
woco logs <feature-id> [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `feature-id` | yes | Feature ID whose logs to display |

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--tail` | `-n` | number |  | Show only the last N lines |
| `--follow` | `-f` | boolean | `false` | Stream new output as it arrives (like tail -f) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
